text: Automated alerts and near-real-time intensity maps are now available to emergency managers; strengthened local capacity; improved evidence base for retrofitting in Lae via the risk project. Quantitative station-level performance metrics are not publicly reported, but the upgrade is expected to lower detection thresholds and improve magnitude/location accuracy.

metadata.solution_name: Upgrade of Seismic Monitoring: Lae Seismic Station (short-period to broadband)
